turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on days and months?
turns.tutor:
Days and months come soon. We start with clock times. Here is one: The shop opens ___ 9:00. Step 1: look after the gap: 9:00. Step 2: that is a clock time. So I write at: The shop opens at 9:00.
The rule: use at before a clock time.
Right: We have dinner at 7:30. Wrong: We have dinner in 7:30.
Now you. Write the missing word.
Write in, on or at: My train leaves ___ 5 o'clock.
